verdict.rationale: Clara's marketing claims "automated expense reporting, approvals and compliance." Its Card Configurations API lets you codify merchant-category, time, and day-of-week restrictions per card, which covers part of the category- and context-based limits. Nothing documents a policy engine that auto-approves in-policy expenses and routes only exceptions to a human. Missing for 10: role-based policy limits, documented auto-approval of in-policy expenses, exception routing to human approvers, approval-workflow configuration docs, independent corroboration.
